existing_atlas_baseline.baseline_correction: The handoff left annual_one_way_pax null and carried APIQROO prose value 5,457,733 for Isla Mujeres. The official APIQROO table exposes ENTRADAS and SALIDAS and supports gross one-way crossing totals; its Isla Mujeres total is 5,458,304, not 5,457,733.

sources.title: Logra Quintana Roo crecimiento sostenido en la actividad marítima durante 2025
sources.publisher: Coordinación General de Comunicación, Government of Quintana Roo / APIQROO
sources.proves: Official prose reports 3,853,770 passengers on Cozumel-Playa del Carmen and 5,457,733 on the Isla Mujeres-Puerto Juárez passenger route. It also reports 27,920 ferry departures for Cozumel-Playa.
sources.confidence: high for publication provenance; medium for Isla exact number because it conflicts with APIQROO statistical table
exact_quotes: En cuanto a la ruta federal Cozumel-Playa del Carmen se consolida como un eje estratégico para la movilidad turística y cotidiana, al registrar 3 millones 853 mil 770 pasajeros, lo que representa un incremento del 8% respecto a 2024, así como 27 mil 920 salidas de ferris, con un crecimiento del 39% en comparación con el año anterior.

En Isla Mujeres, la ruta federal de pasajeros a Puerto Juárez se posiciona como la principal línea de conectividad del municipio, al garantizar el traslado permanente de residentes, trabajadores y visitantes.
Durante 2025 se registraron 5 millones 457 mil 733 pasajeros

sources.title: Ruta de pasajeros — 2025
sources.publisher: Administración Portuaria Integral de Quintana Roo (APIQROO)
sources.proves: Official route table labels passenger columns ENTRADAS and SALIDAS and TOTAL. Cozumel: 1,932,907 entradas + 1,920,863 salidas = 3,853,770. Playa mirrors the same corridor with directions reversed; do not sum the Cozumel and Playa rows. Isla Mujeres: 2,692,716 entradas + 2,765,588 salidas = 5,458,304.

sources.title: Isla Mujeres route-passenger monthly detail — 2025
sources.proves: Monthly official detail sums to 18,876 movement entradas, 19,184 movement salidas, 2,692,716 passenger entradas, 2,765,588 passenger salidas, total 5,458,304 passengers.

sources.title: Cuadro CF86 — Tipo de cambio FIX
sources.proves: Central-bank FIX series SF17908 is denominated pesos per dollar; Banxico describes FIX as the exchange rate used to settle USD obligations payable in Mexico after publication in the Diario Oficial. Monthly-average observations are available for audit and current-period conversions.

sources.title: Official exchange rate (LCU per US$, period average) — Mexico
sources.proves: 2025 official period-average exchange rate is 19.2375083333333 MXN per USD. Used as the consistent, conservative comparable-fare basis.
sources.confidence: high for annual comparative conversion; tier 2 behind Banxico for transaction settlement

sources.title: PPP conversion factor, GDP (LCU per international $) — Mexico
sources.proves: 2025 GDP PPP conversion factor is 10.328951 MXN per international dollar. Dividing by the official exchange rate gives a 0.536917 relative price-level proxy.
sources.confidence: high for source value; medium/low for its use as a Navier operating cost index

sources.title: Capitanes y Conductores de Transporte Marítimo
sources.proves: Official labor profile says the national occupation averaged MXN 9.12k per month in 2026 Q1, with 3.17k workers and about 44.8 hours/week; Quintana Roo had the largest workforce (1.94k). It does not provide a finance-ready employer-loaded senior licensed captain cost for Quintana Roo.
sources.confidence: high for observed survey statistic; low as direct employer-cost input

sources.title: CFE tariff mirror — PDBT, Quintana Roo
sources.publisher: AI Regula Solutions (mirror linking each row to CFE)
sources.proves: Mirror displays CFE PDBT energy charge MXN 3.9680/kWh and fixed charge MXN 45.2600/month for Benito Juárez, Cozumel, Isla Mujeres and Solidaridad, each linked to the official CFE tariff page. Direct CFE automation was blocked by Incapsula, so this is not a primary-source capture.

sources.title: Aviso a los establecimientos sujetos a reporte en el RENE
sources.proves: Because Mexico's 2025 factor was still being estimated, 2026 COA reporting must use the 2024 National Electric System factor: 0.444 tCO2e/MWh, numerically equal to 0.444 kgCO2e/kWh.
sources.exact_quote: se deberá utilizar el factor de emisión del Sistema Eléctrico Nacional 2024 ... 0.444 tCO2e / MWh

fx_basis.recommended_basis: World Bank WDI 2025 official exchange rate, period average
fx_basis.why_suitable: A completed annual average matches the 2025 demand period and provides one reproducible basis for fare comparables. It also yields lower USD fare equivalents than the stronger-peso 2026 monthly averages, making it conservative for modeled revenue. Banxico FIX remains the primary basis for transaction-date settlement/accounting.

Winjet regular adult one-way from Playa, Playa-Cozumel

fx_basis.rounding_policy: Retain full precision in calculations; publish comparables to USD 0.01. Do not recalculate some fares at spot/FIX and others at this annual basis.

country_reference_recommendation.row_status: provisional_T3; grid factor source-ready; energy is a small-business comparator; captain/marina/cost_index are modeled and require finance approval

captain_usd_yr.classification: MODELED, not an official wage fact
captain_usd_yr.source_tier: T1 observed benchmark + T4 model judgment
captain_usd_yr.treatment: Use USD 14,000/year only as a provisional loaded planning allowance for a commercial captain. It deliberately exceeds the national survey cash-wage anchor to allow for licensing, employer burden, seniority and tourist-market hiring, but no operator quote validates the uplift.

energy_usd_kwh.source_tier: T2 mirror of CFE primary tariff + T1 Banxico FX
energy_usd_kwh.calculation: MXN 3.9680/kWh / 17.3819 MXN/USD (Banxico CF86 June 2026 monthly average) = USD 0.228283/kWh; rounded to 0.23
energy_usd_kwh.fixed_charge_context: MXN 45.2600/month / 17.3819 = USD 2.6039/month, excluded from per-kWh value
energy_usd_kwh.treatment: PDBT is a small low-voltage business comparator. It is not a bankable fast-charging tariff and excludes VAT, connection work, demand/capacity/reactive charges and any move to GDBT/GDMTH. Obtain CFE supply study for vessel charging load.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.treatment: Use for 2026 COA-style indirect-emissions calculations until SENER publishes the 2025 factor; relabel vintage as 2024 grid factor.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.classification: MODELED, not a published marina tariff
marina_overhead_usd_yr.calculation: Existing Singapore model anchor USD 20,000 × Mexico relative price proxy 0.536917 = USD 10,738; rounded to USD 11,000. This is model-on-model and not an observed Mexico berth quote.
marina_overhead_usd_yr.treatment: Covers annual berth, port fees and local marine admin per vessel under repo definition; excludes insurance and fast-charge infrastructure. Replace with berth/port/operator quotes for Puerto Juárez, Isla Mujeres, Playa and Cozumel.

cost_index.calculation: 10.328951 MXN/int$ PPP conversion factor / 19.2375083333333 MXN/USD official exchange rate = 0.536917; rounded to 0.54
cost_index.treatment: Use only as a broad relative price-level proxy, not as proof of maritime OPEX. Do not use it to override sourced labor, tariff or marina inputs.

do_not_publish: Do not divide either APIQROO passenger total by two: that would turn gross one-way crossing journeys into approximate round trips and understate corridor_annual_oneway_pax.
Do not multiply by two: both ENTRADAS and SALIDAS are already included.
Do not sum the Cozumel and Playa table rows; they are mirrored endpoint views of the same 3,853,770 corridor journeys.
Do not use 5,457,733 as the canonical Isla Mujeres model total while the official decomposable table says 5,458,304.
Do not assign total corridor passengers to Ultramar, Winjet, Magna, DiDi, Navier or any single Atlas edge.
Do not treat converted public fares as realized yield; discounts, child/resident products, fees and operator mix remain unknown.
Do not describe captain_usd_yr, marina_overhead_usd_yr or cost_index as sourced Mexican facts; they are provisional modeled fields.
Do not treat PDBT USD 0.23/kWh as a fast-charging all-in tariff.
Do not label 0.444 kgCO2e/kWh as a 2025 grid factor; it is the 2024 factor mandated for 2026 reporting while 2025 is pending.
